## Summary

The revision-prefix mismatch should be fixed so running status preserves the identifier promised by its docstring.

## Changes
The pull request adds running deployment status with a shortened revision and attempt number, plus tests for the status format and attempt labels.

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the same revision prefix as history — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, status displays `0123456` while history displays `0123456789ab`. The `revision[:7]` expression contradicts the docstring’s “same identifier as history” promise; history and completion both use `revision[:12]`. — Users receive inconsistent deployment identifiers across running, history, and completion output, making distinct revisions with identical seven-character prefixes indistinguishable while running.
